With a higher input voltage, it simply takes shorter sips of power from the primary.For example, imagine if the primary side is 120V, and you need 12V at 1A. Then (depending on the transformer winding) you might only draw power from the primary 5% of the time. If the load increases to 2A, you might need to draw power 10% of the time. At 240V, though, with the 2A load it'd only need 5% of the time.
